name: Text to human text
desc: Turns text into human text and creates a video

skills.name: humanize
skills.desc: Rewrite AI-generated text to sound like a real human wrote it. Uses your personal voice profile (~/.vibe/voice_profile.yaml) for tone, style, and banned-phrase enforcement. Run with --setup to build or edit your voice profile.

skills.name: showcase
skills.desc: Document and share a Vibe session as a showcase writeup. Creates a Google Doc in the shared Vibe Showcases folder. Use this skill when the user says "showcase", "writeup", "document this session", or wants to share what they accomplished with Vibe.
